calculation_handling.description: Despite 900.1.10(3) and 900.1.10(4)(A), where a detached houseplex is the only residential building on a lot and the applicable Chapter 900 exception sets lot requirements for a detached house, the houseplex is subject to those detached-house lot requirements.
calculation_handling.gaps: Incorporates the lot requirements of whichever Chapter 900 exception applies to the lot; exceptions are not yet keyed. 'The only residential building on a lot' has no condition token. The unit text names no zone (its section is the RT zone).

units.disclosure: On a lot with a site-specific exception, a detached houseplex follows the exception's lot rules for a detached house. We have not yet loaded those exceptions.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 900.1.10(3) and 900.1.10(4)(A), where a semi-detached houseplex is the only residential building on a lot and the applicable Chapter 900 exception sets lot requirements for a semi-detached house, the houseplex is subject to the exception's lot requirements for the portion of a semi-detached house that is one dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Incorporates the lot requirements of whichever Chapter 900 exception applies to the lot; exceptions are not yet keyed. 'The only residential building on a lot' has no condition token. The unit text names no zone (its section is the RT zone).

units.disclosure: On a lot with a site-specific exception, a semi-detached houseplex follows the exception's lot rules for one half of a semi-detached house. We have not yet loaded those exceptions.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.60.30.1(1), 900.1.10(3) and 900.1.10(4)(A), for a lot with a detached houseplex, semi-detached houseplex or a residential building with a secondary suite, whichever maximum lot coverage is more permissive prevails: the base RT coverage in 10.60.30.40 or the Chapter 900 exception coverage that applies through 10.60.30.1(1).
calculation_handling.gaps: Precedence is conditional (the more permissive coverage wins), not a fixed layer order; ranks_layers records that the base 10.60.30.40 coverage can prevail over the exception. Exceptions are not yet keyed, so the comparison cannot be made yet. The unit text names no zone.

10.60.30.1(1).explanation: Where a houseplex is the only home on a lot covered by a site-specific (Chapter 900) exception, it follows the exception's lot rules for a detached house, or for one half of a semi-detached house.

10.60.30.1(2).explanation: For a houseplex or a home with a secondary suite, if the regular RT zone lot coverage limit is more generous than the exception's limit, the more generous one applies.
